nodes.label: PLATYPUS Hybrid Architecture
nodes.rationale: Use of PLATYPUS page/story flow with Canvas callbacks for cover page and headers/footers to combine automatic layout with absolute pixel positioning.

nodes.label: Multi-Key API Rotation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Automatically cycles through up to 5 Gemini API keys upon hitting 429/Resource Exhausted errors, effectively increasing free-tier quota limits by 5x.
